description: This bar chart, titled “Health and Nutrition,” “Logistics,” and “Personal Finance” across three grouped sections, displays stacked bar plots comparing two model variants—“MVS” (green) and “1-MVS” (blue)—across two model sizes (“70B llama” and “8B llama”) for each domain. The vertical axis represents a normalized value ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2, indicating a linear scale. The horizontal axis lists the model size and domain combinations, with “70B llama” and “8B llama” appearing under each domain label. Each bar is divided into two segments: the lower green segment represents the “MVS” component, and the upper blue segment represents the “1-MVS” component. For all categories, the green segment (MVS) is consistently longer than the blue segment (1-MVS), indicating a higher value for MVS. The “70B llama” bars are generally taller than the “8B llama” bars, suggesting a higher overall value for the larger model. The bars are not sorted, and no visual emphasis such as shading or bolding is applied to any specific bar. The legend at the bottom confirms the color coding for “MVS” and “1-MVS.”
